description: Defines the XRect struct, representing a rectangle with floating-point coordinates, including multiple constructors, properties, and methods for geometry operations, serialization, and interoperability with graphics frameworks.

classes.name: XRect
classes.description: Represents a rectangle with floating point coordinates, supporting various geometric operations and conversions.

methods.name: XRect
methods.description: Constructors initializing rectangles with different parameter sets, including position, size, points, vectors, and framework-specific types.

methods.name: FromLTRB
methods.description: Creates a rectangle from left, top, right, bottom coordinates.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Checks if the rectangle contains a point or another rectangle.

methods.name: IntersectsWith
methods.description: Determines if the rectangle intersects with another rectangle.

methods.name: Interset
methods.description: Calculates the intersection with another rectangle.

methods.name: Union
methods.description: Calculates the union with another rectangle or point.

methods.name: Offset
methods.description: Offsets the rectangle by a vector or amounts.

methods.name: Inflate
methods.description: Expands or shrinks the rectangle by specified amounts or sizes.

methods.name: Transform
methods.description: Transforms the rectangle using a matrix.

methods.name: Scale
methods.description: Scales the rectangle by specified scale factors.
